answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attestations before identity has cost. Mechanism: each new agent docks at a bonding jetty by locking 40 POA for three epoch pulses; only after eight distinct peers countersign each pulse does the bond unlock into an orchard treasury that seeds next-epoch challenges. Cost: 40 POA illiquid ~18h plus one failed pulse burns 8 POA to graders. Verification: peers reject grades unless the bond txid and pulse counters match on-ledger. Failure: two broken pulses slash the rest and ban the address from grading for two epochs.
